acceptance_evidence.ac2_in_process_recording_transport_in_st: services/consultation/tests/test_persona_meetings.py::stack configures meeting output routing via services.consultation.meeting_outputs.output_routing_context(transport=_recording_output_transport, store_path=output_ledger_path) and restores/clears routing state via configure_output_routing(transport=None, store_path=None, clear_live_refs=True) after each test so no test opens a network connection to a downstream owner.

acceptance_evidence.ac4_failure_path_covered: Covered both in services/consultation/tests/test_persona_meetings.py::test_mt4_output_transport_connection_error_records_failed_and_meeting_still_closes (transport raises urllib.error.URLError(ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')), proposal is recorded with status='failed', id=None, error containing 'Connection refused', and meeting still closes with status='closed') and in services/consultation/tests/test_meeting_outputs.py::test_dispatch_failure_is_recorded_and_retried_idempotently.
acceptance_evidence.ac5_no_production_code_change: Zero production code changes; only services/consultation/tests/test_persona_meetings.py and this evidence manifest are modified.
